reviews.comment: Dr. Buckley/Creasy is an amazing prof!! She is so sweet and kind. I thought I failed the first exam, but she is a very graceful grader and lets you correct exams for credit. Projects were kind of fun even if they were time-consuming and we ended up taking one closed-note exam and one open-note exam.

Amazing person that really cares about your wellbeing and future. Really forgiving on exams, but the group projects can be confusing sometimes. She doesn't grade too hard though so it shouldn't matter much anyway. Presented a lot of cool opportunities and people to us, and also gave us food like ice cream and chips so she has my heart
my queen!!!!!! super sweet. lots of tasting labs (chips, ice cream) which made the class fun and enjoyable. tests aren't super difficult, just follow the study guide.

Dr. Creasy is a pretty solid professor. She is very kind and caring. We had a packback and quiz due weekly, 2 projects throughout the semester, and 3 exams. I felt like the exams were sometimes difficult, but if you study you will get an A. She did not always post modules on time which was sometimes frustrating, but overall I would recommend

It was a very easy online class that required little work each week. Each week there was a packback and a quiz that had multiple attempts. Tests were not difficult and were on respondus. No cumulative final. Projects were fun and graded easily.

Genuinely one of the sweetest people of all time. It's easy to stop paying attention in there sometimes which could end up kicking you. We took one in person exam, one online exam, and the final was option online or in person. These were not set in stone, she literally asked us what we wanted to do. She tries to make class fun. 2 projects but easy.

I love Dr. Creasy. She was more than caring and passionate about what she taught and loved to interact personally with everyone in her class. Her exams are reasonable and the two projects that are given are fun. I'm going to miss her after finishing this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was a very interesting class. Professor Creasy was great. The material isn't too difficult, but there is a lot of work with quizzes and packbacks and a couple of exams and projects.

Dr. Creasy was great at encouraging students to apply information taught in her class to "the real world". She was quick to respond to emails and very generous when I needed an extension on an assignment for personal reasons. She is the kind of professor who truly values her students and wants you to succeed.

Dr. Creasy is one of the kindest teachers I have ever had and always tries to help you succeed. If you're looking for an easy science credit, this isn't exactly the class to take. But if you are decent at science and can't find anything else, take her! 3 tests, weekly quizzes, and weekly packback assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You can tell that Dr. Creasy cares a lot about what she teaches. She actively asks the class what learning styles suit them and tries to shape her lectures around the class.

The work for this class isn't bad. packback & quiz due every sunday. 3 exams. Prof Creasy just isn't very dependable.She is kind of on her own schedule.Supposed to give access to the modules at the beginning of each week- that never happened. She posts whenever she feels throughout the week (wed or thurs) leaving you barely any time left before due

I loved taking this class with professor Creasy! She is very caring and easy to reach outside of class. Also, her lectures are very interesting and I truly felt like I learned a lot in this course. There were weekly packbacks, 3 exams, and a couple of projects. Overall, this class was really enjoyable and I would definitely take her again.

She is super sweet and the material is pretty basic. About 3 tests (MC, matching and short answer), final and 3 assignments. While she doesn't take roll, TopHat questions count as participation and for a grade. Also be sure to not miss review days, she will do a short Kahoot, 12 questions or so,  at the end with questions very similar to the exam.

Professor Creasy is the kindest professor I've ever met. She's easy to reach outside of class and is always available for help. She is also very understanding about the college student lifestyle so if theres an issue, reach out! The hardest thing was definitely the tests, but there are many extra point opportunities to help your grade as well!

Dr.C is a great professor. You have weekly quizzes and discussions with three exams and a final. A couple of projects that are pretty time-consuming so don't wait until the last minute. Overall good class, great professor!

ABSOLUTELY LOVE PROFESSOR CREASY! She is amazing! Implemented "healthy snack Fridays" and is super understanding and caring about students and their situations. Super flexible when the class needed more time to go over certain modules and listened to our feedback. Extra credit is given through TopHat assignments so come to class! Overall, love her!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Creasey is such a gem! Doesn't expect perfection so she is lenient on everything. Lectures are a little lengthy and based off PowerPoints so going to class is recommended but she gives access to notes and PowerPoints for every module. Projects were fun and not graded super hard. An easy A is possible if you put in the work.
Her criteria are clear and her lectures are easy to follow! However, she tends to take a while to answer emails.

Dr. Creasy was great, great class! Quick trigger warning, as someone who has struggled with disordered eating, the final project included keeping a food log and tracking nutrition and that was a triggering for me. Im sure she might offer an alternative assignment if you discuss it with her, she seems very kind and sweet, but something to note!
She is a doll! Absolutely amazing!!! Take her if you can!!! She works with you and is so so kind. 10/10 recommend.

I loved nutrition & learned SO much! Creasy is super nice & approachable. Tests come straight from lecture videos & are proctored so you do need to study! The projects aren't bad, but they are tedious. Material was harder than expected but that's b/c she goes into detail. Only bad thing is, she is slow to reply to emails. Easy A if you work!

Dr. Creasy is a good prof! Study and do well on the exams so that you won't have to take the final! She gives extra credit for being in class and participating in the iclicker questions. As long as you sit in class and fill out the notes, you'll do well. The review she gives out is exactly like the test, so make sure you know that and you're good.

Dr. Creasy is such a sweet lady!  The class is not hard; all you need to do is show up and fill out her power points (she posts incomplete versions on eCampus).  She does do iClicker questions and other in-class "participation activities," so you do need to attend class.  3 tests, 1 diet analysis project, and the final.  I highly recommend Dr. C!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Pretty easy A.... go to class for the power points and usually crammed for tests and got an A!
She is a great professor to take.

Creasy is a nice lady, but she is a boring lecturer. Notes are fill-in-the-blank, but the information is not always in the book so you have to attend class (the book is actually useless). She assigns one project that is insanely long and detailed. Do not expect a quick turnaround on graded papers, but go to her office hours to look over old tests.

Lectures take the whole class period and are dull. Just fill in the blank powerpoints.   Didn't need the textbook, powerpoints were enough. Gives extra credit for showing up to class and extra iClicker questions. Tests are difficult and hard to study for, but final replaces lowest test grade. Project is a free A as a test grade if you complete it.

She gives you a power point to fill in for notes, however, her lectures are just reading off the slides so she doesn't really teach. She moves very quickly and covers a lot of material in one class so skipping is not a good idea. There are also random clicker questions. VERY SLOW GRADER 3 weeks for a scantron. There are 3 test, a final,& a project.
